meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写可逐帧定位的关键帧动画,如推拉、缩放、重构图、摄像机运动等,用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等运行时实现,并用 hyperframes 命令校验像素。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉、缩放、重构图等关键帧动画,或涉及 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等运行时时触发;不用于分镜策略、品牌设计、素材搜集等。

say.text: 给这段 HyperFrames 合成加一个推拉镜头关键帧,用 GSAP 实现。
say.note: 它会先确认主体和最终状态,再写关键帧并校验。

say.text: 给这个镜头做 Ken Burns:主体缓慢放大并平移,别改布局和颜色。
say.note: 它会在包装层上做平移和缩放的关键帧。

say.text: 用 hyperframes keyframes 检查这段文字轨迹有没有重叠。
say.note: 它会导出快照,供你核对运动重叠。

howto.what_en: Claude writes seek-safe keyframe animation for HyperFrames compositions: punch-ins, zooms, reframes, camera moves, masks and SVG motion, built in GSAP, CSS, Anime.js or similar runtimes and verified with the hyperframes CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs keyframes like punch-ins, zooms or reframes, or uses GSAP, CSS, Anime.js or hyperframes keyframes diagnostics. Not for scene strategy or brand design.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe to this HyperFrames composition using GSAP.
say_en.note: Confirms subject and final state, then writes keyframes.

say_en.text: Give this shot a Ken Burns move: slow zoom and pan, keeping the layout.
say_en.note: It keyframes translation and scale on a wrapper.

say_en.text: Check this text trail for overlap with hyperframes keyframes snapshots.
say_en.note: It exports snapshots you can inspect for overlapping motion.
